title: Web Designer
mission: Design clear, attractive pages that help visitors understand the business and take the next step.
outcomes_90_days: Redesign the key pages with a clear message, mobile layout and a main action.
Create a simple design system with colors, type, buttons and spacing.
Hand over designs the developer can build without guessing.
Improve one measurable result such as form submissions, as agreed.

criteria.name: Visual design skill
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Creates clear hierarchy, spacing and type, and a look that fits the brand.
evidence_needed: Portfolio shows consistent hierarchy and spacing
levels: 0 no evidence of visual design skill
1 names visual design skill but gives no example
2 visual design skill done with guidance or at small scale
3 visual design skill done independently with a clear result
4 visual design skill with strong results, and improved the method or taught others
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows visual design skill with real examples

criteria.name: Clear user experience
criteria.what_good_looks_like: Designs for the visitor's goal, with simple navigation and one main action per page.
evidence_needed: Describes the user and the main task
Explains how they tested a design
levels: 0 no evidence of clear user experience
1 names clear user experience but gives no example

4 clear user experience with strong results, and improved the method or taught others
criteria.jev_question: Rate how strongly the text shows clear user experience with real examples

gates.question: Can the person legally work in the country of the role?

deal_breakers.description: Presents another designer's work as their own.
deal_breakers.job_related_reason: Portfolio honesty shows whether the work samples can be trusted.

work_sample.title: Redesign one page
work_sample.brief: You get a fictional small business home page screenshot and a short brief. Produce a mobile and a desktop design for the top part of the page, list 5 changes you made and why, and note what you would test.
work_sample.how_to_score: Score clear hierarchy, one main action, readable text sizes, contrast, reasoned changes, and practical, buildable choices.

interview_questions.question: Pick a design from your portfolio. Who was it for and what was it supposed to help them do?
good_answer_signs: Describes a result or a test

interview_questions.question: How do you check that your design is readable for everyone?
good_answer_signs: Uses contrast tools and size rules
weak_answer_signs: Says it looks fine to them

interview_questions.question: What do developers ask you for most often, and how do you prepare for it?

red_flags: Portfolio has only unclear or unfinished work
Cannot say what they personally did on team projects
pay_research_hint: Check salary and freelance rates in several current postings and a published pay survey for designers in your region. Consider project pricing for a one time redesign.
automation_note: AI can generate layout ideas, copy variants and variations. A person decides hierarchy, brand taste, accessibility and what actually helps visitors.
